## Why visit

A useful Castlefield stop combining changing cask with a serious continental range. The small frontage leads into a deeper, relaxed bar, and the ability to bring in food makes it unusually practical for an unfussy meal during a beer day. Its selection offers a different emphasis from the historic pubs around Great Bridgewater Street, without requiring a detour into another district. This is particularly worthwhile when you want a regional cask alongside German or Belgian choices and a straightforward, informal setting.

## Beer

Four handpumps with changing local and Yorkshire cask are documented, alongside continental bottles and keg.

## Food

Bar snacks only, but CAMRA reports that outside food and next-door fish and chips are welcomed if you clear away the packaging. Confirm the policy on arrival.

## Plan the visit

This is the Liverpool Road branch, not the canal-side Ancoats branch. Basement toilets involve steep stairs.

**Getting there:** Walk from Deansgate or Deansgate-Castlefield; combine with Britons Protection.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
